items_all.title: World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows
items_all.summary: Current world models like Sora or Genie only simulate physics and ignore what people think, want, or feel. The new "Mental World Modeling" framework adds mental variables like beliefs and intentions. Even weaker language models using this approach outperform stronger models without mental modeling. The biggest bottleneck: predicting how physical and mental states change together. The article World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 當前的世界模型（例如 Sora 或 Genie）僅模擬物理，而忽略人們的想法、想要或感受。新的“心理世界建模”框架新增了信念和意圖等心理變數。即使使用這種方法的較弱的語言模型也優於沒有心理建模的較強的模型。最大的瓶頸：預測身體和精神狀態如何一起變化。新研究顯示，《忽略人類信念的世界模型預測錯誤行為》一文首先出現在解碼器上。

items_all.title: Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic
items_all.summary: Netflix pitted its years-old recommendation engine against an in-house language model called GenRec and says it got better results. Instead of relying on thousands of hand-crafted features, GenRec converts viewing behavior into plain text. Netflix itself calls it "an early but promising step." The article Netflix tests language model as alternative to hand-built recommendation logic appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Netflix 將其已有多年曆史的推薦引擎與名為 GenRec 的內部語言模型進行了比較，並表示獲得了更好的結果。 GenRec 不依賴數千個手工製作的功能，而是將觀看行為轉換為純文字。 Netflix 自己稱其為“早期但有希望的一步”。 Netflix 測試語言模型作為手工構建推薦邏輯的替代品的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing
items_all.summary: Researchers at the UK AI Security Institute used psychometric methods to show that popular safety benchmarks for language models don't measure one consistent trait. Blanket blocking of requests can artificially inflate a safety score even as the model gets less useful day to day. The study also offers a method for catching models that act more cautious during tests than they do in normal use. The article Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 英國人工智慧安全研究所的研究人員使用心理測量方法表明，流行的語言模型安全基準並不能衡量一種一致的特徵。即使模型的用處日益減少，對請求的全面阻止也會人為地提高安全分數。該研究還提供了一種方法來捕獲在測試期間比正常使用時表現得更加謹慎的模型。文章《心理學方法揭示人工智慧安全測試的主要弱點》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access
items_all.summary: Anthropic has moved its most cyber-capable model into a product security teams can switch on themselves. Claude Security scans now run on Claude Mythos 5, in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers with no separate model add-on. The scan connects to a GitHub repository, traces data flows across files, and returns findings with a CWE category, confidence and severity ratings, and a suggested patch. The design point is packaging: users receive a scan result rather than a prompt box, so the model that finds vulnerabilities cannot be steered into writing exploits. The post Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 已將其最具網路能力的模型轉變為安全團隊可以自行切換的產品。 Claude 安全掃描現在在 Claude Mythos 5 上執行，這是針對 Claude Enterprise 客戶的公開測試版，沒有單獨的模型附加元件。掃描連線到 GitHub 儲存庫，跟蹤檔案之間的資料流，並返回包含 CWE 類別、置信度和嚴重性評級以及建議補丁的結果。設計要點是打包：使用者收到的是掃描結果而不是提示框，因此發現漏洞的模型無法引導編寫漏洞利用程式。 Anthropic 將 Claude Mythos 5 引入 Claude 安全性：企業團隊無需直接模型訪問即可進行前沿漏洞掃描一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all.title: llm 0.32.1
items_all.summary: Release: llm 0.32.1 Fresh installs of LLM stopped working the other day because the OpenAI Python library dropped its usage of httpx , and it turned out LLM depended on that library but only installed it via a transitive openai dependency. This dot-release fixes that for the moment by pinning to openai<3 , and a soon-to-drop 0.33 release will switch from httpx to httpx2 . Tags: httpx , openai , llm
items_all.summary_zh: 版本：llm 0.32.1 前幾天，新安裝的 LLM 停止工作，因為 OpenAI Python 庫放棄了 httpx 的使用，結果發現 LLM 依賴於該庫，但僅透過傳遞 openai 依賴項安裝它。這個點版本透過固定到 openai<3 暫時修復了這個問題，並且即將釋出的 0.33 版本將從 httpx 切換到 httpx2 。標籤： httpx , openai , llm

items_all.title: Stop Making TUIs
items_all.summary: Stop Making TUIs Thomas Ptacek advocates for building real native user interfaces for even the smallest of personal tools, because coding agents have reduced the cost of getting a usable-enough GUI up and running to almost nothing. I wrote about my vibe-coded bandwidth and GPU monitoring macOS task bar apps back in March , and I'm still using both of those on a daily basis. I'm not habitually knocking out real UIs for my other projects yet, but I'm running out of excuses! Thomas: If you haven’t tried your hand at turning one of your 500 throwaway CLIs into a native app, you’re doing yourself a disservice. Go build a native UI. It’ll probably change the way you think. Tags: thomas-ptacek , ai , generative-ai , llms , vibe-coding , coding-agents

items_all.title: Quoting Matt Webb
items_all.summary: After I released version 1.0, I figured I would have to do the rotations myself. So I sat down with ChatGPT and I didn’t get it to write the code, but I got it to educate me. With a patient, interactive tutor, I was able to finally do what I hadn’t by reading books and asking mathematician friends – I learnt how to use quaternions just enough to make the app work. So learning doesn’t stop just because I outsource a bunch of thinking to AI. It pushes me to learn more. I like that as an outcome. — Matt Webb , Galactic Compass 2: now with new augmented reality mode Tags: matt-webb , generative-ai , chatgpt , education , ai , llms

items_all_raw.title: World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows
items_all_raw.summary: Current world models like Sora or Genie only simulate physics and ignore what people think, want, or feel. The new "Mental World Modeling" framework adds mental variables like beliefs and intentions. Even weaker language models using this approach outperform stronger models without mental modeling. The biggest bottleneck: predicting how physical and mental states change together. The article World models that ignore human beliefs predict the wrong actions, new research shows appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 當前的世界模型（例如 Sora 或 Genie）僅模擬物理，而忽略人們的想法、想要或感受。新的“心理世界建模”框架新增了信念和意圖等心理變數。即使使用這種方法的較弱的語言模型也優於沒有心理建模的較強的模型。最大的瓶頸：預測身體和精神狀態如何一起變化。新研究顯示，《忽略人類信念的世界模型預測錯誤行為》一文首先出現在解碼器上。

items_all_raw.title: Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing
items_all_raw.summary: Researchers at the UK AI Security Institute used psychometric methods to show that popular safety benchmarks for language models don't measure one consistent trait. Blanket blocking of requests can artificially inflate a safety score even as the model gets less useful day to day. The study also offers a method for catching models that act more cautious during tests than they do in normal use. The article Psychological methods reveal major weaknesses in AI security testing appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 英國人工智慧安全研究所的研究人員使用心理測量方法表明，流行的語言模型安全基準並不能衡量一種一致的特徵。即使模型的用處日益減少，對請求的全面阻止也會人為地提高安全分數。該研究還提供了一種方法來捕獲在測試期間比正常使用時表現得更加謹慎的模型。文章《心理學方法揭示人工智慧安全測試的主要弱點》首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic has moved its most cyber-capable model into a product security teams can switch on themselves. Claude Security scans now run on Claude Mythos 5, in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers with no separate model add-on. The scan connects to a GitHub repository, traces data flows across files, and returns findings with a CWE category, confidence and severity ratings, and a suggested patch. The design point is packaging: users receive a scan result rather than a prompt box, so the model that finds vulnerabilities cannot be steered into writing exploits. The post Anthropic Brings Claude Mythos 5 to Claude Security: Enterprise Teams Get Frontier Vulnerability Scanning Without Direct Model Access appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 已將其最具網路能力的模型轉變為安全團隊可以自行切換的產品。 Claude 安全掃描現在在 Claude Mythos 5 上執行，這是針對 Claude Enterprise 客戶的公開測試版，沒有單獨的模型附加元件。掃描連線到 GitHub 儲存庫，跟蹤檔案之間的資料流，並返回包含 CWE 類別、置信度和嚴重性評級以及建議補丁的結果。設計要點是打包：使用者收到的是掃描結果而不是提示框，因此發現漏洞的模型無法引導編寫漏洞利用程式。 Anthropic 將 Claude Mythos 5 引入 Claude 安全性：企業團隊無需直接模型訪問即可進行前沿漏洞掃描一文首先出現在 MarkTechPost 上。

items_all_raw.summary: Stop Making TUIs Thomas Ptacek advocates for building real native user interfaces for even the smallest of personal tools, because coding agents have reduced the cost of getting a usable-enough GUI up and running to almost nothing. I wrote about my vibe-coded bandwidth and GPU monitoring macOS task bar apps back in March , and I'm still using both of those on a daily basis. I'm not habitually knocking out real UIs for my other projects yet, but I'm running out of excuses! Thomas: If you haven’t tried your hand at turning one of your 500 throwaway CLIs into a native app, you’re doing yourself a disservice. Go build a native UI. It’ll probably change the way you think. items_all_raw.title: Slack推出Slack Code，讓團隊與AI代理人共同開發程式
items_all_raw.summary: Salesforce週四（8/20）推出Slack Code，讓企業團隊可在Slack中與AI程式代理人共同開發、檢視及修改程式碼。 Slack過去已能整合各種AI代理人，但相關功能主要用於對話及個別任務。隨著Claude Code、Devin、GitHub Copilot及ChatGPT等代理人開始處理更複雜的程式開發，開發者與AI的討論及修改過程通常只有自己看得到，其他團隊成員難以同步參與。
